label: Rises when the observer believes S2 is good, mostly at GO, and after choosing a2.
terms: (phase == GO) * np.tanh(belief_lo) ;; (phase != GO) * np.tanh(belief_lo) ;; (phase == D1) * (ep_trial == 0) ;; (phase == GO) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 u") ;; (phase == GO) * last_is("a2 S1 r") ;; (phase == D2)*(action==2) ;; (phase == GO)*(prev_action==2)*(prev_reward==1)
explanation: The raw candidate value of unit 23 is almost always near -0.96. Beyond timing it is graded by the ideal observer belief: it goes up (less negative) when S2 is believed good and down when S1 is, and this is about 4x stronger at GO than at D1/D2. At GO it is also higher after a previous a2 choice. On the episode first D1 it is much higher (+0.26). The free fit adds that at GO an a2-rewarded previous trial cancels the prev-a2 boost (because belief already carries it), plus a small boost at D2 after choosing a2. No future, hidden or model-output variables are used.

issues: The 'after choosing a2' claim is wrong in a way that matters. The GO boost comes almost entirely after an UNREWARDED a2. Replacing (phase == GO)*(prev_action == 2) with (phase == GO)*(prev_action == 2)*(prev_reward == 0) raises test R^2 beyond timing from 0.605 to 0.678, with tanh(belief_lo) kept unchanged. Adding plain prev_action==2 back next to the unrewarded term lowers the score (0.665 vs 0.688), so a rewarded a2 adds nothing. The profile shows the same thing: GO residual after a2 S1 u is +0.090 and after a2 S2 u +0.039, but after a2 S1 r it is -0.008.

Misses on the recorded short form show this as the largest systematic error: GO after a2 S1 u is under-predicted by +0.034 and GO after a2 S2 u by +0.030, while GO after a2 S1 r is over-predicted by -0.022 and GO after a2 S2 r by -0.019.

The belief shape is too saturating. np.tanh(belief_lo/2), which equals 2*P(S1 good)-1 and is linear in the probability, does better than np.tanh(belief_lo). With the corrected second term it scores 0.688 vs 0.678 on test.
The prev_action==2 term in the recorded form adds only +0.019 on test (0.586 without it, 0.605 with it). Most of what the short form misses is the reward condition.
The episode-first D1 jump (+0.27) checks out: dropping that term costs about 0.027 on test.
Remaining errors, smaller ones: late-episode runs of a2 (around trials 91-98) are under-predicted at GO, actual about -0.65 vs predicted about -0.79. D1 after a2 S1 r is under-predicted by +0.038.
skeptic.revised_label: Rises in proportion to belief that S2 is good (strongest at GO), and at GO after an unrewarded a2.

final_label: Rises in proportion to belief that S2 is good (strongest at GO), and at GO after an unrewarded a2.
